messages:
sam: Deploy bot reported production deploy of service-router @ 6429876543 commit abc1234 to green pool. traffic: 0% -> 100% by default.

deploy-bot: [deploy] service-router v2.4.0 deployed to green cluster
commit: abc1234
link: https://ci.example.com/build/8421
status: success

maria: Wait—we had a note about session-stickiness change. Was that included in the release notes? 

sam: Yes, updated cookie ttl from 5m -> 15m. Mentioned in release notes, but worth flagging. 

jonathan: Observability: p95 latency for route /generate spiked 12% in canary earlier. Wasn't passed to SLO alert. Checking metrics now. 

ravi: Dashboard: https://dash.example/servicerouter/green
no errors but p95 is ~260ms vs baseline 230ms. CPU on green pods ~78% 

maria: If CPU keeps rising above 80% for 5m we should start a rollback. Agree? 

sam: Agreed. Rollback criteria: CPU > 80% for 5m OR p95 > 300ms OR error rate > 0.5%. If any met, initiate immediate router weight shift to blue and open rollback. 

kevin: Also add session loss check: active websockets drop >2% in 2m -> rollback. 

jonathan: I'll keep an eye. Setting a short watch window: 30m change window. 

deploy-bot: [route] shifting traffic: green -> 30% at 6429876570 (manual partial shift)

sam: Manual probe started. Please run a few heavy queries from loadtest (loadtest:regional-smoke) and post results. 

ravi: Loadtest run id: lt-993, 100 rps, 2m: p95 275ms, errors 0.12% 

maria: Looks within thresholds so far. Continue watch. 

kevin: Noted. I pinned rolling update version in console to v2.4.0 so autoscaler won't evict older pods. 

sam: Good. If stable at 30m mark, we finish cutover. If not, rollback plan: deploy-bot to re-route 100% to blue and trigger ops-runbook. 

jonathan: I have an automation ready: /scripts/route-swap --from green --to blue --reason rollback

maria: Thanks. I'll update release notes with the session cookie TTL finer detail and a known-issue flag for latency regression investigation. 

sam: For audibility, adding incident tag and kicking off post-mortem if we roll back. Fingers crossed. :crossed_fingers: 

deploy-bot: [monitor] 10m watch active for service-router (alerts suppressed for noise). 

ravi: CPU trending up to 81% 6429876615 — starting rollback now per policy. 

deploy-bot: [route] shifting traffic: green -> 0%, blue -> 100% (rollback) at 6429876620

sam: Rollback executed. Team, please run the rollback post-checklist and capture logs. 

jonathan: Collecting logs and creating post-rollback ticket. link: https://pm.example/ticket/RO-1122

maria: Update release notes with rollback summary and hold v2.4.0 until follow-up.

kevin: Revert pin in console after blue stable. 

ravi: All clear on blue, metrics back to baseline. Closing watch. 

sam: Thanks everyone — we'll regroup in the morning for root cause. :thumbsup:
